notes: Category/type are approximations — VIA Connect² is a wireless/wired presentation & collaboration gateway (BYOD screen-sharing box), which does not map cleanly onto any of the provided type enum values; 'Encoder/Decoder' and category 'control' were chosen as the closest fits since it encodes a wired HDMI source and decodes wireless/network streams to an HDMI display, with network-based control/management (VSM). Not rack-mountable (omit rackUnits) — it is a super-compact 74x74x33mm puck-style unit designed for VESA/desk/behind-display mounting. The '2 Pin connector: Video Switching control' spec item is a proprietary 2-pin connector (ships with a dedicated control cable) used to trigger an external video switcher/display, not a power or standard audio/data connector — mapped to 'euroblock' as the closest available id since no generic 2-pin control connector exists in the taxonomy; treat with caution. Power is rated 12V DC / 1.3A, supplied by an included external power adapter (brick), hence connector 'dc-barrel' rather than an AC inlet on the unit itself. All grades confirmed from the official Kramer/Full Compass spec sheet PDF (HDMI 2.0 in/out up to 4K@60 4:2:0; 1x Gigabit LAN; 2x USB 3.0 + 1x USB 2.0). Model name is officially styled 'VIA Connect²' (superscript 2) — also commonly written 'VIA Connect2'.

ports.name: Video Switching Control
ports.note: Proprietary 2-pin connector for video-switching control/relay trigger, not a standard Euroblock terminal block; closest available connector id in taxonomy.
